message.jaymoskingdoms.medallion.no_bind: Only a spell rests in the medallion; %s is said from the board
message.jaymoskingdoms.medallion.cooling: The medallion is still warm from the last prayer
message.jaymoskingdoms.medallion.fizzle: The marks fade: no prayer you know begins so
message.jaymoskingdoms.medallion.none: You know no prayer that has a pattern yet
message.jaymoskingdoms.medallion.no_targ: No one before you to judge
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.297: No numpad? While a Cleric's medallion board is up, the number keys 1 to 9 lay its marks too, and pick no hotbar slot.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.298: A holy symbol can be worn at the neck in the amulet slot. Worn there it still raises the medallion board and blesses the band, but casting with a tap and turning the dead want it in hand.
